title: US sanctions push SeaLead Shipping into liquidation
content: Singapore-headquartered SeaLead Shipping is being liquidated, marking the final chapter in one of container shipping’s most dramatic rises and falls of recent years. title: ADNOC L&S makes $1.3bn VLCC and VLGC swoop
content: Abu Dhabi-listed ADNOC Logistics & Services has put $1.3bn to work on an 11-ship buying spree, picking up six VLCCs and five VLGCs through secondhand and newbuild resale deals.
